I have resolved the issue where the MySQL backend used deprecated `"db"` and `"passwd"` keyword arguments.

### Summary of Changes
1. **[django/db/backends/mysql/base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d8pxrd2l/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L202-L205)**: Updated `get_connection_params()` to use `"database"` and `"password"` kwargs instead of `"db"` and `"passwd"`.
2. **[django/db/backends/mysql/client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d8pxrd2l/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L11)**: Updated `settings_to_cmd_args_env()` to check for `"database"` in `OPTIONS` (with fallback to `"db"` and `NAME`).
3. **[tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-d8pxrd2l/tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py#L61-L63)**: Updated dbshell test cases to use `'database'` and `'password'` in `OPTIONS`.
